card.fact_statement: Measurements by the James Webb Space Telescope indicate 2024 YR4 has a diameter of 60 m.
card.source_span: Measurements of 2024 YR4's mid-infrared thermal emission by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) on 26 March 2025 indicate that it has a diameter of 60 m (200 ft)
